name: launch_debugger
root: Launch and control EDT debug sessions. Pass action and its parameters; snake_case and camelCase actions are accepted. action=help topic=workflow describes the workflow; standalone tools remain callable as compatibility aliases.

descriptions.action: Action: launch / add_breakpoint / remove_breakpoint / list_breakpoints / set_exception_breakpoint / run_to_line / wait_for_break / get_state / get_variables / set_variable / step_over / step_into / step_out / step / resume / pause_thread / set_breakpoint_state / terminate / evaluate / start_profiling / get_profiling_results / debug_status / help (snake_case canonical; camelCase like addBreakpoint accepted).
descriptions.topic: With action=help: workflow describes the typical debug sequence; omitted topic lists actions.
descriptions.find: With help: search this help for a case-insensitive substring - all the words must appear inside one chunk, and with topic only that topic is searched.
descriptions.launchConfigurationName: launch: exact EDT runtime-client or Attach configuration name. Selects a client by name or an Attach configuration for server-side debugging (HTTP services/background/scheduled jobs).
descriptions.updateBeforeLaunch: launch: update database first (default true; ignored for Attach). With update_database disabled by preset: omitted launches without update and returns databaseUpdate=SKIPPED_BY_PRESET; explicit true refused.
descriptions.debugServerPort: launch: debug server port, 1..65535, when another 1C:EDT holds the default.
descriptions.enableExternalObjectDump: launch: enable dump generation in project settings. If off and service answers, or service unreachable: refused (Nothing was launched). true refused by write door of a preset that blocks writing.
descriptions.externalObjectName: launch: external processor/report project to open in a client launch configuration. Import an existing .epf/.erf first via external_object_workshop operation=import_external_object. Refused for Attach; nothing launched.
descriptions.externalObjectProject: launch: external-object project containing externalObjectName; client configurations only; Attach refused.
descriptions.startupOption: launch: /C only on this launch's copy; saved configuration is not changed. /Execute is set by the environment from externalObjectName, not this argument. Refused for Attach or an already running client.
descriptions.clientType: launch: thin/thick/web; omitted=launch configuration's type (new configuration: thin; ordinary mode: always thick). Applied to this launch's configuration copy; a new configuration is saved with the choice.
descriptions.runMode: launch: ordinary/managed; omitted=config default. For this EDT session, ordinary adds /RunModeOrdinaryApplication to infobase additional launch parameters, managed removes it. Disk list unchanged; response reports changes.
descriptions.waitForEndpoint: launch: URL must respond before ready (final status <500, at most five redirects). If it never responds, launch is NOT stopped; refusal reports this.
descriptions.endpointTimeoutSeconds: launch: waitForEndpoint wait (default 20, limit 50); refused without waitForEndpoint.
descriptions.runKey: launch: resume a launch that answered Pending, by the runKey it answered with.
descriptions.all: terminate: stop every active EDT launch (default false).
descriptions.modulePath: BSL module path for breakpoint actions.
descriptions.breakpoints: add_breakpoint batch: JSON array of {modulePath|module, line|lineNumber, optional condition, hitCount, hitCondition, logExpression}; items inherit omitted projectName.
descriptions.breakpointId: Breakpoint identifier for remove_breakpoint and set_breakpoint_state.
descriptions.breakpointEnabled: set_breakpoint_state: true enables the breakpoint, false disables without removal; refuses a call without it.
descriptions.replaceModuleSet: add_breakpoint batch: remove addressed modules' current breakpoints so batch becomes their entire set (default false).
descriptions.message: set_exception_breakpoint: break only for exceptions whose text matches this message; omitted=any error.
descriptions.catchAll: set_exception_breakpoint: break on any raised error; default true, false if message set. Explicit value overrides.
descriptions.frameRef: Stack frame reference for get_variables / evaluate.
descriptions.threadId: Thread ID from wait_for_break: alternative to frameRef for get_variables/set_variable; resume target for step/resume/run_to_line; pause_thread suspends only this thread.
descriptions.frameIndex: 0-based stack-frame index, used with threadId for get_variables / set_variable (default 0).
descriptions.expandPath: get_variables: dot-separated path into a nested variable to expand (e.g. Struct.Field).
descriptions.scope: get_variables: locals (default)/module/all (locals, module variables, module properties); ignored with expandPath.
descriptions.mode: Bare step action: over, into or out. step_over, step_into and step_out set it.
descriptions.timeoutSeconds: wait_for_break/step: seconds, 1..50; larger values clamp to 50 and are reported. Aliases: timeoutMs, waitSeconds, timeout.
descriptions.module: BSL module path for run_to_line (module-relative or absolute).
descriptions.path: Variable name (dot-separated for nested) for set_variable.
descriptions.value: New value as a BSL expression for set_variable.
